saw_lines: Manga readers pick the app that carries their series, then stay for the next chapter and renew without rethinking.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a reader either sees their series or keeps scrolling.
Your 10 of 23 copy ads open on the same mangas hook, so one line carries the account. Run three new angles on simulcast, chapters and exclusives, one per ad.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: 10 of 23 copy ads open on “des mangas iconiques en HD”, so one line carries the account and a reader who skips it sees nothing new. Run three angles on simulcast, new chapters and exclusives, one per ad.

One exact copy runs in 10 of 23 ads, so the same pitch reaches the same people and feels stale fast. Keep the copy but rewrite the opening line and swap the creative in each, so every version opens fresh.

None of your 30 ads carries a proof number, so a stranger choosing a reading app has nothing to trust. Collect one figure, such as your app store review count, and open two ads with it. Print it on the creative.
2 of your 23 ads are creator posts run from the brand page, so the creator’s trust stops at the first frame. Whitelist both posts from the creator account and cut three variations of each.

ads_1: Fresh hooks on simulcast, new chapters and exclusives, tested one per ad
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
